## File: facebookresearch_parlai/projects/wizard_of_wikipedia/knowledge_retriever/knowledge_retriever.py

Prompts

```
['create a KnowledgeRetrieverAgent instance with opt dict to retrieve Wikipedia passages for Wizard of Wikipedia dialogue', 'run tfidf_retriever_act to retrieve and combine passages from chosen topic, wizard, and apprentice utterances', 'test get_passages to format retrieved text candidates into sentences with optional title prefix', 'review maintain_retriever_history to track dialogue turns between wizard and apprentice agents', 'refactor get_chosen_topic_passages to extract sentences from a chosen Wikipedia topic via wiki_map lookup']
```

Usage

```
{'create_knowledge_retriever_agent': 'create a KnowledgeRetrieverAgent instance with opt dict to retrieve Wikipedia passages for Wizard of Wikipedia dialogue', 'run_tfidf_retriever_act': 'run tfidf_retriever_act to retrieve and combine passages from chosen topic, wizard, and apprentice utterances', 'test_get_passages': 'test get_passages to format retrieved text candidates into sentences with optional title prefix', 'review_maintain_retriever_history': 'review maintain_retriever_history to track dialogue turns between wizard and apprentice agents', 'refactor_get_chosen_topic_passages': 'refactor get_chosen_topic_passages to extract sentences from a chosen Wikipedia topic via wiki_map lookup'}
```
